description: This file defines the EventAdapter interface, which extends the Adapter interface for objects of type Event. It specifies default methods for retrieving criteria, actions, and response applicability related to event topics, acting as an adapter pattern component within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter context.

classes.name: EventAdapter
classes.description: An interface that maps Event objects to an adaptable form and vice versa, providing default behavior for criteria, actions, and response handling within the protocol adapter framework.

methods.name: getCriteria
methods.description: Returns a set containing the EVENT criterion indicating this adapter handles event-based topics.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Returns a set of actions (CREATED, MODIFIED, DELETED) relevant for the event topics this adapter is concerned with.

methods.name: isForResponses
methods.description: Indicates whether this adapter is meant for responses; returns false.
